title: MOST POWERFUL PSALM 63 EARLY MORNING PRAYER TO COMMAND THE DAY
text: Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Hallelujah. Before we begin, before a single word goes forth tonight, I want you to do something for me. If you are watching this, if you are connected to this service right now, wherever you are in the world, I want you to share this link. Share it. Send it to someone. You might be the bridge between someone and their miracle. God might use you as an instrument tonight to change the life of somebody you have never met. Share this broadcast. Send it to your family. Send it to that friend who has been going through. You do not know what God is about to do in this service. Share it now. Now lift your hands wherever you are. Just begin to worship him. Begin to worship the Lord. We're not in a hurry tonight. We're not going anywhere. The Holy Spirit is here. And when the Holy Spirit is here, everything changes. Sing with me now. You are worthy, oh Lord. You are worthy of it all. You are worthy. My heart says yes. My spirit says yes. Lord, I give you praise tonight. I give you glory tonight. [music] There is none like you, Father. In all the earth, there is none like you. Oh, we worship you tonight, Jesus. We worship you, lamb of God. We worship you, the bright and morning star. We worship you, the lily of the valley. We worship you, the ancient of days. We worship you, the one who was and is and is to come. Father, we honor you. We magnify your name. We lift you high above every other name. Above sickness, above poverty, above delay, above confusion. Your name is above. Your name is above. Your name is above. There is a sound coming from this place tonight. There is a frequency being released in the realm of the spirit. And I hear the Lord saying, "I have been waiting for you. I have been waiting for this moment. I have been waiting for you to come before my presence with expectation. So worship him. Do not worship casually. Worship him like your life depends on it because it does. Your breakthrough is connected to your worship. Your healing is connected to your worship. Your deliverance is connected to your worship. So give him everything tonight. Jehovah we love you. Jehovah we adore you. Jehovah we celebrate you tonight. You are the God who heals. You are the God who delivers. You are the God who restores. You are the God who makes a way where there seems to be no way. And tonight we have come before your throne with thanksgiving and into your courts with praise. Just one more minute in his presence. Stay there. Stay in that place of worship. Do not leave. Do not allow anything to distract you. The enemy wants to steal this moment from you. He wants you to check your phone. He wants you to get up. He wants you to lose focus. But I say to you tonight, stay in his presence. Stay. Worthy is the lamb that was slain. Worthy is the lamb that was slain. Worthy, worthy, worthy. You are worthy, Lord Jesus. Receive our praise tonight. Receive our worship tonight. Receive the adoration of your people. Receive the cry of hearts that are hungry. Receive the tears of those who are desperate. You are worthy of it all. Yes, Lord. Yes, Lord. The spirit of God is moving. I can sense it. I can feel it in my spirit. Something is happening in the realm of the spirit right now. The atmosphere is shifting. The heavens are opening. Angels are taking their positions. Thank you, Father. Thank you, Lord. We bless your name. We give you glory. Be magnified, oh God. Be magnified in this place. Be magnified in every home connected to this service. Be magnified in every life that is under the sound of this voice. You are great and greatly to be praised. Hallelujah. You may be seated in the presence of the Lord. There is a scripture I want us to look at tonight and I believe with everything in me that the Holy Spirit specifically chose this passage for somebody connected to this service. Open your Bibles to the book of Psalm 63:es 1-4. Psalm 63:es 1-4. The psalmist David under the inspiration of the Holy Spirit wrote these words. And notice what he says. He says, "Oh God, thou art my God. Early will I seek thee. My soul thirsteth for thee. My flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land where no water is to see thy power and thy glory. So as I have seen thee in the sanctuary, because thy loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee. Thus will I bless thee while I leave. I will lift up my hands in thy name. Did you hear that? Early will I seek thee. Not late, not when everything else has been tried, not when every other option has failed. Early at daybreak, before the sun rises, before the noise of life begins, before the demands of the day come knocking at your door, early will I seek thee. [music] There is something about the early morning that the spirit of God wants to reveal to you tonight. There is a mystery locked in the morning hours that many believers have never tapped into. And I am telling you by the authority of the spirit, if you can learn the discipline of the dawn, if you can learn to rise before the sun and seek the face of God, your life will never remain the same. [music] Look at somebody and say, early. Say it again, early. Write this down. The morning is not just a time. The morning is a spiritual gateway. It is an access point. It is a portal into dimensions of God's power that are not available at any other time. I know that sounds controversial, but let me show you from scripture. Look at the book of Mark 1:35. The Bible says, "And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, Jesus went out and departed into a solitary place and there prayed." If Jesus, the son of the living God, the one through whom all things were made, the alpha and the omega, the beginning and the end, if he found it necessary to wake up early and pray, who are you to think you can afford to sleep through the most powerful hours of the day? I am not trying to put you under condemnation. I am trying to wake you up literally and spiritually because there are dimensions of glory. There are realms of power. There are encounters with God that are reserved for those who are willing to pay the price of the morning. And David understood this. This psalm was written when David was in the wilderness of Judah. He was running. He was being pursued. His life was in danger. Saul was after him. His own son Abselum had betrayed him. Everything that could go wrong had gone wrong. He was in a dry and thirsty land where there was no water. But notice what he did not do. He did not complain. He did not murmur. He did not give up. He said, "Oh God, thou art my God, early will I seek thee." When your life is falling apart, seek him early. When your marriage is under attack, seek him early. When your finances are crumbling, seek him early. When your health report is negative, seek him early. When your children are going astray, seek him early. When the enemy is closing in on every side, seek him early. Because there is something that happens when you meet God before the day begins. You set the agenda of your day from the throne room. You download the blueprint of heaven before the enemy can upload his plans. You receive marching orders from the commander of the armies of heaven before the battle starts. Let me tell you something. The reason many believers are losing battles they should be winning is because they are showing up late to the war room. By the time they pray, the enemy has already established his operations for the day. By the time they open their mouths, the forces of darkness have already been deployed. But when you rise early, when you seek him at daybreak, you get ahead of the enemy. You ambush the ambusher. You surprise the one who thought he would surprise you. Now, let me take you deeper because this is not just about waking up physically. There is a spiritual dimension to what I am about to say. In the book of Exodus 34:2, God said to Moses, "Be ready in the morning and come up in the morning onto Mount Si and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount." Be ready in the morning, present yourself. There is a presentation that God requires. It is not casual. It is not haphazard. It is intentional. It is deliberate. It is sacrificial. You are presenting yourself before the most high God. You are standing in the throne room of the universe. You are approaching the one before whom angels cover their faces and cry, "Holy, holy, holy." And when you present yourself in the morning, something happens. God begins to show you things. He begins to reveal mysteries. He begins to download strategies. He begins to open your eyes to see what the natural eye cannot see. He begins to speak to you about your future. He begins to warn you about traps. He begins to direct your steps. Listen to me carefully. Proverbs 8:1 17 says, "I love them that love me, and those that seek me early shall find me. Those that seek me early shall find me." There is a promise attached to early seeking. There is a guarantee from heaven that if you will seek God early, you will find him. Not might find him. Not could find him shall find him. It is a divine certainty. It is a covenant promise from the mouth of God himself. How many of you want to find God? How many of you are tired of dry seasons? How many of you are tired of feeling far from his presence? How many of you want encounters that change everything? Then seek him early. Seek him at daybreak. Set your alarm. Discipline your flesh. Tell your body that it does not control you. Tell your mattress that it cannot hold you hostage. Tell sleep that it will not steal your destiny. Because I need you to understand something tonight. Your destiny is connected to your discipline. Your future is connected to your faithfulness. Your breakthrough is connected to your commitment to the morning altar. Let me show you something else. In the book of Isaiah 50:4, the Bible says, "The Lord God had given me the tongue of the learned that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary. He wakenth morning by morning. He wakenth my ear to hear as the learned." [music] He wakenth morning by morning. God himself is waking you up. That alarm you set is not just a piece of technology. It is the finger of God reaching into your natural world to pull you into a supernatural encounter. When you wake up in the morning, it is not coincidence. It is divine invitation. God is saying, "Come, come and meet with me. Come and receive what I have for you. Come and be transformed by my glory." And the result of this morning encounter is profound. He says, "He has given me the tongue of the lannet." That means when you seek God early, you receive wisdom. You receive understanding. You receive the right words for the right situations. You know how to speak to the weary. You know how to navigate complex situations. You know how to lead. You know how to build. You know how to love. All because you met with God in the morning. Look at Genesis chapter 19 27. Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he stood before the Lord. [music] Abraham had a place. He had a spot. He had a location where he consistently stood before the Lord. Let me ask you tonight, do you have a place? [music] Do you have a spot? Do you have a location in your home where the carpet is worn out from your knees? Where the atmosphere is thick with the presence of God because you have been there so many times that heaven knows the coordinates. Some of you need to establish an altar in your home. You need to designate a place. It does not have to be fancy. It can be a corner of your room. It can be your closet. It can be your living room floor. But it needs to be a place where you meet with God consistently. A place where heaven opens up every time you show up. A place where demons tremble because they know what happens there. Now look at this. In the book of Lamentations 3:es 22- 23, the Bible says, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." New every morning. God's mercies are new every morning. That means every single day there is a fresh download of mercy waiting for you. A fresh batch of compassion, a fresh supply of grace, a fresh measure of favor, but you have to show up to collect it. You have to be awake to receive it. It is like mana in the wilderness. It was available in the morning, but if you slept in, you missed it. By the time the sun came up, it melted. Some of you have been living on yesterday's mercy. You have been surviving on last week's grace. You have been running on fumes of an encounter you had months ago. And God is saying there is fresh supply waiting for you every morning, but you have to come and get it. Hosea 6:3 says, "Then shall we know if we follow on to know the Lord? His going forth is prepared as the morning, and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain onto the earth." His going forth is prepared as the morning. God has prepared something in the morning for you. It is already set up. It is already arranged. The table is already spread. The meal is already prepared. The blessing is already packaged. The answer is already written. The healing is already released. The breakthrough is already signed and sealed. But you have to show up at the right time to receive it. In Psalm 5:3, David says, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up. There is a posture that the morning requires. You pray and then you look up. You release your petition and then you lift your expectations. You speak to God and then you watch for the answer. You worship and then you wait because God is faithful and when you seek him early, he responds. Now I want to shift into something deeper because the title of this session is not just about a general morning prayer. It is about seeking him at daybreak. There is a specific instruction in that phrase. Daybreak. The moment when darkness gives way to light. The moment when night surreners its hold. The moment when the first ray of the sun pierces through the horizon. And prophetically some of you are daybreak right now. You have been in a season of darkness. You have been in a season of night. You have been in a season where you could not see your way. Where everything was obscured, where the path was hidden, where the future was unclear. But I am telling you tonight, it is daybreak for you. The night is over. The darkness is lifting. The light of God's glory is breaking through. And as you seek him in this moment, in this transition from darkness to light, everything is about to change. Say it out loud. It is my daybreak. Say it again. It is my daybreak. [music] In the book of Judges chapter 19, there is a tragic story. But hidden in that story is a powerful principle. The Bible records that certain events happened because the morning light came. When morning came, the dynamic changed. When daybreak arrived, the situation shifted. And I am prophesying over your life tonight. Morning has come for you. Daybreak has arrived for you. The season of weeping through the night is over because joy is coming in the morning. Psalm 30:5 for his anger endureth but a moment. In his favor is life. Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning. Your night of weeping is over. Your night of pain is over. Your night of sorrow is over. Your night of lack is over. Your night of barness is over. Your night of confusion is over. Your night of rejection is over. Joy is coming in the morning. And this is your morning. I sense something very strongly right now. The Holy Spirit is highlighting something to me. There is someone connected to this service. And for the past 3 years, you have been in a cycle. a cycle of almost. Almost getting the job, almost closing the deal, almost getting married, almost getting healed, almost breaking through, but something always stops it at the last minute. The spirit of God is saying to you tonight, the spirit of almost is broken over your life. From this night forward, almost becomes accomplished. Almost becomes done. Almost becomes settled. Almost becomes manifested. Receive that word. Receive it now. Let it drop into your spirit. Let it settle in your heart. It is not just words. It is spirit [music] and it is life. Jesus said in John 6:63, "The words that I speak unto you, they are spirit and they are life." Now, let me go even deeper because the Holy Spirit is taking us somewhere. When David said, "My soul thirsted for thee. My flesh longed for thee. He was describing a level of desperation that most believers have never experienced. His soul was thirsty. His flesh was longing. Every fiber of his being was crying out for the presence of God. Can I be honest with you tonight? The reason many believers never experience the deep things of God is because they are not desperate enough. They are comfortable. They are satisfied with the status quo. They are okay with having a form of godliness but denying the power thereof. [music] They are content with knowing about God without actually knowing God. But David [music] was desperate. And desperation creates access. Desperation opens doors that nothing else can open. Desperation catches the attention of heaven. When you are desperate for God, heaven notices. Angels are dispatched. The Holy Spirit moves. The father leans in. Jesus intercedes with a fresh urgency. How desperate are you tonight? Are you here just to listen? Are you here just to pass time? Or are you here because your life depends on what God is about to do? Are you here because you know that without a move of God, nothing will change. Are you here because you are tired of managing your problems and you want God to destroy them? If that is you, I want you to stand up wherever you are. Stand on your feet because we're about to enter into a dimension of prayer that will shake the foundations of everything that has been holding you back. Before we pray, let me give you one more scripture. 2 Samuel 23:4 says, "And he shall be as the light of the morning when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds, [music] and as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear, shining after rain. A morning without clouds." That is what God is bringing to you. A season without clouds, a season without obstruction, a season without the haze of confusion and delay. Clear shining after rain, after the storm, after the pain, after the trial, there is clear shining, and it is coming to you now. Also write this down. Psalm 143:8. Cause me to hear thy loving kindness in the morning. For indeed do I trust. cause me to know the way wherein I should walk. For I lift up my soul unto thee. That is the prayer of a man who is saying, God, I do not just want to hear noise in the morning. I want to hear your loving kindness. I want to hear your tender voice. I want to hear the direction of heaven. I want to know which way to walk. I want to know which decision to make. I want to know which door to enter and which door to avoid. Are you ready to pray? >> Are you really ready? Because the kind of prayer we are about to enter into is not ordinary. It is not casual. It is not religious. It is warfare. It is prophetic. It is apostolic. It is the kind of prayer that rearranges the order of the spirit realm and forces the natural to align with the supernatural. Lift your right hand to heaven right now. Open your mouth and begin to pray. Begin to cry out. Begin to call upon the name of the Lord. For the Bible says in Joel 2:32, "And it shall come to pass that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be delivered." Father, in the name of Jesus, we come before your throne tonight. [music] We come not on the merit of our own righteousness, but on the merit of the blood of the lamb. We come through the door that was opened by the sacrifice of Calvary. We come through the veil that was torn. We come boldly because you said we could come boldly onto the throne of grace to obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. And tonight, oh God, is our time of need. We need you, Father. We need your hand to move. We need your voice to speak. We need your power to break every chain. We need your fire to consume every walk of darkness. We need your glory to fill every empty place. We need you, Lord. We need you. Yes, Lord. Yes, Lord. The spirit of God is moving. Let him have his way. Do not resist him. Do not grieve him. Let him move. Let him touch. Let him heal. Let him deliver. Let him restore. Right now, in the name of Jesus, I come against every spirit that has been assigned to keep you asleep during the morning hours. Every spirit of slumber, every spirit of slothfulness, every spirit of laziness that has been programmed against your morning altar, I command it to break right now in the name of Jesus. The Bible says in Romans 13:1, "And that knowing the time that now it is high time to awake out of sleep, for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed." I decree over your life tonight, you are waking up spiritually. You are waking up. Every device of the enemy to keep you in spiritual slumber is destroyed by fire. Every enchantment, every spell, every witchcraft operation designed to keep you asleep while your destiny is being stolen, I command it to catch fire right now in the mighty name of Jesus. Pray with your mouth. Do not be silent. There is power in the sound of your voice. When you open your mouth, angels receive instructions. When you speak the word of God, demons flee. When you cry out, heaven responds. So, open your mouth and pray. Father, I pray for every person connected to this service. I pray that the spirit of the early riser will fall upon them tonight. That from this day forward, they will arise before the sun and meet you at the altar of the morning. that their eyes will open with expectation, that their hearts will burn with desire, that their lips will be ready with praise, that their spirits will be tuned to the frequency of heaven in the name of Jesus. I break every pattern of spiritual dryness. I break every cycle of prayerlessness. I break every habit that has kept you far from the presence of God. Psalm 63 says, "In a dry and thirsty land where no water is." Some of you have been living in a spiritual desert. Your prayer life is dry. Your worship is dry. Your hunger for God has diminished. And the enemy has been taking advantage of this dryness to plant seeds of destruction in your life. But tonight, I decree that the rain of the Holy Spirit is falling on your life. fresh rain, supernatural rain, the kind of rain that makes dry bones live again, the kind of rain that turns a desert into a garden, the kind of rain that breaks famine and brings harvest. Ezekiel 37:4 again he said unto me, "Prophesy upon these bones and say unto them, oh ye dry bones, hear the word of the Lord. I prophesy upon every dry area of your life. [music] I prophesy upon your dry marriage. Live again. I prophesy upon your dry finances. Live again. I prophesy upon your dry career. Live again. I prophesy upon your dry ministry. Live again. I prophesy upon your dry health. Live again. I prophesy upon your dry faith. Live again. Hear the word of the Lord. Oh dry bones, leave. Leave. Leave. Shabaand. The power of God is here. The healing virtue of the Holy Spirit is being released right now. I can sense it in my spirit. Somebody is being healed right now. That pain in your body, that sickness that the doctors could not explain, the disease, that medicine could not cure, the affliction that has tormented you for years, the fire of God is burning it out of your body right now in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. I speak to every infirmity. I speak to every sickness. I speak to every disease. I speak to every condition. The same Jesus who healed the woman with the issue of blood. The same Jesus who opened blind eyes. The same Jesus who made the lame to walk. The same Jesus who cleansed the leper. That same Jesus is here tonight. And he is touching your body right now. Isaiah 53:5. But he was wounded for our transgressions. He was bruised for our iniquities. The chastisement of our peace was upon him. And with his stripes, we are healed. With his stripes, you are healed. Not you will be healed. Not you might be healed. You are healed. It is a finished work. It was settled at Calvary. It was purchased with blood. And tonight, you are receiving the manifestation of that healing. Put your hand on that part of your body where you feel pain. Put your hand on that area where the diagnosis was given and receive your healing now in the name of Jesus. Cancer die. Tumor dissolve. Diabetes your power is broken. High blood pressure normalize. Fibroid you are uprooted. Kidney disease your hold is destroyed. Every affliction, every infirmity, every sickness, your time is up in the name of Jesus. Be healed. Be healed. be healed. Now I am moving to another dimension of prayer. Stay with me. Do not lose focus. I want to pray for your destiny tonight because the enemy has been very strategic in his attacks against your purpose. He knows that if you ever wake up to who you really are, his kingdom is in trouble. He knows that if you ever step into the fullness of your calling, the gates of hell will not prevail. So he has been working over time to delay you, to distract you, to derail you, to discourage you, to deceive you. But tonight we are dismantling every operation of hell against your destiny. In the name of Jesus, I come against every spirit of delay. Every assignment of delay that has been placed upon your life from the kingdom of darkness. I nullify it by the blood of the lamb. You should have been married by now, but delay held you back. You should have gotten that promotion by now, but delay blocked it. You should have had that child by now, but delay stole your time. You should have built that house by now, but delay drained your resources. I [music] decree tonight, the spirit of delay is broken, broken, broken, broken. Habac 2:3, for the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Though it tar, wait for it, because it will surely come. It will not tarry. I decree that everything God has promised you that has been delayed will be accelerated. What should have taken 5 years will happen in 5 months. What should have taken one year will happen in one week. What should have taken a month will happen in a day. Acceleration is your portion. Speed is your portion. The God of suddenly is visiting your life tonight. Pray. Pray with fire. Pray with authority. Pray like someone who knows who they are. Pray like a king. Pray like a priest. Pray like a son of the most high God because that is exactly what you are. Shaba shakati. Let the fire fall. Let the fire fall. Let the fire of the Holy Ghost consume every hindrance. Let the fire of God burn every obstacle. Let the fire of heaven destroy every barrier. I release the blessing of the Lord upon you. I release the keeping power of God upon you. I release the shining face of God upon you. I release grace upon you. I release peace upon you. The peace that surpasses all understanding. The peace that guards your heart and mind. The peace that keeps you steady when everything around you is shaking. Go in peace. Go in power. Go in victory. Go in faith. Go with the confidence that the God who started this work in you will complete it. Philippians 1:6. Being confident of this very thing that he which had begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ. It is not over until God says it is over. And God has not said it is over. He has said it is just beginning. The best days of your life are ahead of you, not behind you. The greatest miracles are coming, not past. The most powerful encounters are on the way. Get [music] ready. Set your alarm. Wake up early. Seek him at daybreak and watch what the God of heaven will do in your life in the mighty, matchless, glorious, allsufficient, all powerful, allconquering, eternally prevailing name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. And every person who believes it say amen. Amen. Amen. Amen.
